kebab_example: aliyun tablestore list-instances --status normal --max-results 100 --next-token CAESCG15aC1xxxxx --instance-name instance --resource-group-id rg-aek24upgom6p5ri --instance-name-list instance-test --tag Value=Tester Key=Owner --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListInstances

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of instances that you want to return. Valid values: 0 to 200. If you do not configure this parameter or set this parameter to 0, the default value of 100 is used
parameters.help_zh: 返回实例的最大个数，取值范围为0~200。不设置此参数或者设置为0时，则默认值为100
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The token that determines the start position of the query. Set this parameter to the value of the NextToken parameter that is returned from the last call. Instances are returned in lexicographical order starting from the position that is specified by this parameter. The first time you call the operation, leave this parameter empty
parameters.help_zh: 查询凭证（Token），取值为上一次API调用返回的NextToken参数值。从NextToken开始按字典序返回实例列表。第一次调用此接口时，设置为空
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The name of the instance. Fuzzy search is supported
parameters.help_zh: 实例名称，支持模糊搜索
parameters.name: instance_name

parameters.help_en: The resource group ID. You can query the ID on the Resource Group page in the Resource Management console
parameters.help_zh: 资源组ID，可通过资源组控制台查询
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en: The names of the instances. This parameter is used to specify multiple instances that you want to query at the same time
parameters.help_zh: 实例名称列表，用于批量查询多个指定实例
parameters.name: instance_name_list

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the instance was created

InstanceName.description_en: The name of the instance, which is used to uniquely identify the instance
InstanceName.description_zh: 实例名称，用于唯一标识一个实例

InstanceSpecification.description_en:
The type of the instance.

SSD: high-performance instance
HYBRID: capacity instance
InstanceSpecification.description_zh:
实例规格。
SSD：高性能。
HYBRID：容量型

InstanceStatus.description_en:
The status of the instance.

normal: The instance runs as expected.
forbidden: The instance is disabled.
Deleting: The instance is being released
InstanceStatus.description_zh:
实例状态。
normal：正常。
forbidden：禁用。
deleting：释放中

IsMultiAZ.description_en:
Indicates whether zone-redundant storage (ZRS) is enabled for the instance.

true: ZRS is enabled for the instance.
false: Locally redundant storage (LRS) is enabled for the instance
IsMultiAZ.description_zh:
是否同城冗余。
true：是，表示同城冗余。
false：否，表示本地冗余
IsMultiAZ.title_en: 冗余类型。true表示同城冗余，false表示本地冗余
IsMultiAZ.title_zh: 冗余类型。true表示同城冗余，false表示本地冗余

PaymentType.description_en:
The billing method.

Subscription: subscription
PayAsYouGo: pay as you go
PaymentType.description_zh:
付费方式。
Subscription：包年包月。
PayAsYouGo：按量付费

ResourceGroupId.description_en: The ID of the resource group

StorageType.description_en:
The storage type.

SSD: high-performance
HYBRID: capacity
StorageType.description_zh:
存储类型。
SSD：高性能。
HYBRID：容量型

NextToken.description_en: The token that determines the start position of the next query. If this parameter is empty, all instances that you want to query are returned
NextToken.description_zh: 当预期返回的实例总数大于设置的MaxResults时，将作为查询后续页的凭证。只有当实例未全部返回时，此参数才有值

RequestId.description_en: The request ID, which can be used to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 请求ID，可用于排查和定位问题

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of instances returned
